description: INPADOC legal status for a patent family, sourced from the EPO's worldwide legal-status database — grant, lapse, opposition, withdrawal, appeal and renewal-fee events as reported by the national/regional offices that know about this filing. Answers "is this patent still in force" and "did it lapse for non-payment of a renewal fee", which get_biblio, get_family and get_claims cannot. A European patent can stay in force in some contracting states while lapsing in others, so events are grouped per publication/country rather than collapsed into one in-force flag — read each member's events to see which jurisdiction a given event applies to. Each event carries an `influence` of "negative" (lapse, withdrawal, refusal, revocation), "positive" (grant, renewal, fee paid) or "neutral" (procedural/informational). Give the publication number as printed on the document; a trailing kind code is handled for you. Requires _apiKey=consumer_key:consumer_secret.

number.description: Publication number as printed on the document, e.g. "EP1234567", "CN117928705A", "US10000000", or a PCT international publication like "WO2025028566" / "WO 2025/028566" / "WO2025028566A1". Spaces, commas and slashes are ignored, and a trailing kind code (the "A" / "A1" / "B1" suffix) is retried without it if the exact form is not indexed.
